instruction: Look at gui_006_bracket_L.step in SolidWorks, a single L bracket. In this image, open SOLIDWORKS 2025 from its desktop shortcut, then load `gui_006_bracket_L.step`. The base plate spans X=-40 to X=40, Y=-25 to Y=25, and Z=0 to Z=8. The vertical plate spans X=-40 to X=40, Y=17 to Y=25, and Z=8 to Z=68. Cut two vertical through mounting holes through the base plate, with hole axes parallel to Z, diameter 9 mm, centered at X=+/-25 and Y=0; each hole passes through the base thickness from Z=0 to Z=8. Add one horizontal obround slot through the vertical plate along Y, total length 32 mm in X, width 10 mm in Z, centered at X=0 and Z=35. Add two symmetric triangular gussets centered at X=+/-20; each gusset is 6 mm thick in X and has 35 mm right-angle legs from the inside corner at Y=17, Z=8. Export C:\Users\User\Desktop\gui_006_bracket_reinforced_out.step as one connected solid.
